# Wildman Athletica Programs

> > Training programs and educational resources from Mark Wildman specializing in kettlebells, heavy clubs, mobility work, and unconventional strength training.

Wildman Athletica offers structured fitness programs including specialized training for deconditioned individuals (TOI), mobility-focused protocols like shin box drills, and strength training with kettlebells and clubs. The platform combines Mark Wildman's expertise in athletic training with practical workout plans for various fitness levels.

## Key Topics

- Mark Wildman
- shin box drills
- 90/90 position
- hip mobility
- kettlebell exercises
- heavy clubs
- mobility training
- injury prevention
- Turkish get-up
- grappling strength
- BJJ training
- Training for Overweight and Deconditioned Individuals (TOI)
- bodyweight training
- core exercises
- strength training

## Training Programs

- [Wildman Athletica Programs](https://programs.wildmanathletica.com): Main training programs hub for Wildman Athletica fitness tools & bundles

## Mobility & Hip Training

- [Fix Your Hips, Save Your Back (90/90 Shin Box Drills)](https://programs.wildmanathletica.com/blog/fix-your-hips-save-your-back-90-90-shin-box-drills): Mark & Will Safford cover 90/90 shin box drills for hip mobility
- [Use The Shin Box Hip Snap To Build Grappling Power & Mobility](https://programs.wildmanathletica.com/blog/shin-box-for-grappling-power-mobility): Shin box exercises for BJJ grappling power and hip mobility training
